scopeNote: The modern city: Sukhumvit (Asok to Ekkamai and Phra Khanong), Silom, Sathorn and Chan Road away from the river, Siam, Langsuan, Samyan and Banthat Thong, Victory Monument, Ari and Saphan Khwai, Chatuchak and Ratchada, plus Baan Tepa in Bang Kapi.

items.name: Sorn
items.nameThai: ศรณ์
items.gmapsQuery: Sorn, 56 Sukhumvit 26, Khlong Toei, Bangkok
items.priceText: Set southern Thai tasting menu only. It was 6,500 THB++ in July 2022 (Time Out) and costs more now; the booking page shows the current price.
dishes: Gems on crab stick: crab roasted in the shell and mixed with house chilli paste
Southern curries with rice cooked in clay pots
Phuket lobster, Andaman squid and Tapi River prawns
items.praise: The first Thai restaurant in the world with three Michelin stars (2025), kept in the 2026 guide. Time Out (Mar 2025) says the bolder, spicier dishes show the kitchen best and that a table "isn't easy" to get.
items.watchOut: Book months ahead. Closed on Saturdays. The menu is fixed, so give allergies when you book. A new seasonal menu starts in early January 2027.
items.description: Chef Supaksorn "Ice" Jongsiri cooks a long southern Thai tasting menu in a house on Sukhumvit 26, with fish and produce from the south. The top Thai dinner in Bangkok.
items.bestTime: Dinner. Book as soon as the dates you want open.
tips: Book on TableCheck from sornfinesouthern.com or email reservation@sornfinesouthern.com; phone enquiries 14:00-18:00 on +66 99 081 1119.
A table for 8 is hard to get here; for the whole group, R-Haan's private room is easier.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, opens 18:00 today, pin). Michelin page (three stars, hours) and the Michelin Thailand 2026 star list. Time Out review (13 Mar 2025). Official site: seasonal menu on set dates Oct-Nov 2026, full launch early Jan 2027.

items.name: Sühring
items.gmapsQuery: Sühring, 10 Soi Yen Akat 3, Chong Nonsi, Bangkok
items.michelin: Three Michelin Stars, Thailand 2026 (promoted from two)
items.priceText: Tasting menu only; no current price found online (Oct 2026). Michelin price band 4 of 4.
dishes: Modern German tasting menu built on the chefs' family recipes
Seasonal produce that is fermented, pickled and cured in house

items.watchOut: Closed Monday and Tuesday; Wednesday is dinner only. Not Thai food: choose it if the group wants a European special dinner.
items.description: Twin chefs Thomas and Mathias Sühring serve a German tasting menu in a restored 1970s villa with a garden in Yen Akat, south Sathorn.
items.openText: Wed 18:00-22:00; Thu-Sun 12:30-14:30 and 18:00-22:00; closed Mon-Tue (Michelin Guide, Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Lunch Thu-Sun is easier to book than dinner.
tips: Ask for the kitchen counter when you book.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.6, closed Tue, pin). Michelin page (three stars 2026, hours) and the Michelin 2026 star list (marked new at three stars).

items.name: R-Haan
items.nameThai: อาหาร
items.gmapsQuery: R-Haan, 131 Sukhumvit 53 (Thonglor Soi 9), Bangkok
items.priceText: Thai tasting menus only; prices are not listed on the website (Oct 2026). Michelin price band 4 of 4.
dishes: Crab roe and yellow chilli relish with fresh vegetables and fruit
Tom yam served from a siphon
Seasonal menus (summer, rainy season, winter) and a royal Thai menu

items.openText: Daily 18:00-23:00 (official site and Michelin Guide, Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Dinner; book the private room for the group.
tips: Book at r-haan.com, by phone +66 95 141 5524 (10:30-23:00) or reservation@r-haan.com.
Walk-ins can sit in the bar area, but the full menu needs a booking.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, opens 18:00, pin). Michelin page (two stars, daily 18:00-23:00). Official site: private room 8-12 guests, book 7 days ahead, phone and email.

items.name: Le Du
items.nameThai: ฤดู
items.gmapsQuery: Le Du, 399/3 Silom Soi 7, Bangkok
items.priceText: Le Du Journey 4,500 THB++ and Le Du Experience 5,500 THB++ (4 or 6 courses; official booking page, read Oct 2026).
dishes: Khao kluk kapi with river prawns, the chef's signature
Seasonal Thai menu that changes through the year

items.watchOut: Groups of more than 5 must take the 6-course menu. Changes or cancellations within 72 hours cost 5,000 THB per person.
items.description: Chef Ton Thitid Tassanakajohn's seasonal Thai tasting menu on Silom Soi 7, under a ceiling of 20,000 test tubes. Easier to book than Sorn.
tips: Book at ledubkk.com; everyone at the table takes the same number of courses.
Send diet requests at least 72 hours before.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.1, opens 18:00, pin). Michelin page (one star, hours). Official booking page: menus 4,500 and 5,500 THB++, group and cancellation rules.

items.name: Gaggan

dishes: Progressive Indian tasting menu served as a show by chef Gaggan Anand

tips: Request a table through gaggan.com, or WhatsApp or Line +66 98 883 1022.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, closed today Tue, pin). Michelin page (star, hours Thu-Mon 17:00-00:00). gaggan.com: open Thursday-Monday.

items.name: Baan Tepa
items.nameThai: บ้านเทพา
items.gmapsQuery: Baan Tepa Culinary Space, 561 Ramkhamhaeng Road, Bangkok
items.michelin: Two Michelin Stars and Michelin Green Star, Thailand 2026
items.priceText: Seven-course tasting menu; price not shown on the website (Oct 2026). Michelin price band 4 of 4.

"Dong Dang" rice noodles made with an Udon Thani method
"Crab Crab Crab" with crabs from several regions

items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, closed today Tue, pin). Michelin page (two stars, Green Star, hours). Official site (signature dishes, Michelin and Asia's 50 Best logos).

dishes: Moo cha muang: pork belly curry with sour cha muang leaves, a Chanthaburi dish

Chicken massaman with roti, green curry

Share moo cha muang, the crab noodles and one curry per two people.

Stir-fried crab with herbs and chilli, smoky from the wok
Spicy seafood salads

Deep-fried tofu that soaks up the broth

Stir-fried prawns with sator beans and shrimp paste

Red grouper

items.name: Hongte Pork Leg
items.gmapsQuery: Hongte Pork Leg, 1 Sathu Pradit Road, Chong Nonsi, Bangkok
items.priceText: Rice with braised pork leg 60 THB (Time Out, Sep 2024).
dishes: Khao kha moo: braised pork leg on rice, Shantou style with 32 spices
Extra-large plate of pork leg with skin and fat
items.praise: Time Out (Sep 2024) puts it in its 10 best kha moo in Bangkok: it began as a food cart in 1978, and the extra-large size is the one to order.
items.description: A khao kha moo shop on Sathu Pradit Road, south of Sathorn, with a long-simmered spiced pork leg.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, open, pin). Time Out list (20 Sep 2024).

items.name: Arunwan
items.nameThai: อรุณวรรณ
items.gmapsQuery: Arunwan, Park X Building, 295 Ekkamai Soi 15, Bangkok
items.priceText: Kuay jab with basil and crispy pork 90 THB, egg noodles with crispy pork 80 THB, crispy pork rice 77 THB, crispy pork plate 68 THB (Phuket101 menu, Apr 2025).
dishes: Pork offal soup with pickled cabbage, the house soup
Kuay jab and egg noodles with crispy pork
Crispy pork wontons with sweet black sauce
items.praise: Michelin (2026) says the soup tastes fresh, with the cabbage balancing the sweet pork broth. Phuket101 (Apr 2025): the family recipes date from 1963 and regulars have followed it through four moves.
items.watchOut: Cash only. Closes at 19:00.
items.description: A Thai-Chinese pork noodle shop open since 1963, now on the lower ground floor of Park X on Ekkamai. Almost the whole menu is pork.
items.bestTime: Lunch; pair it with Wattana Panich nearby.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.6, open until 19:00, pin). Michelin page (2026 selection, hours, cash only). Phuket101 (updated 28 Apr 2025, menu prices, 4.6 from 1,554 Google reviews).

items.name: Toy Kuay Teow Ruea (Doy boat noodles)
items.nameThai: ก๋วยเตี๋ยวเรือ ต้อย
items.gmapsQuery: Toy Kuay Teow Ruea, Ratchawithi Soi 18, Bangkok
items.priceText: Small bowls; no current price found online. Bowls at the nearby Boat Noodle Alley were 12-14 THB in 2022.
dishes: Boat noodles with pork in a dark, spiced broth thickened with blood
Beef boat noodles
items.praise: Mark Wiens (Migrationology) calls it the best boat noodle shop in Bangkok. Seasoned Traveller (Feb 2022) suggests it over Boat Noodle Alley for a more traditional bowl.
items.watchOut: A lunch shop; older guides say the noodles sell out by about 15:00. Plain and hot inside.
items.description: A canal-side shop in a soi off Ratchawithi Road, west of Victory Monument, serving rich boat noodles in small bowls.
tips: Order three to five small bowls each.
Boat Noodle Alley (Pa Yak and others) is about 1 km east along the canal, under the Victory Monument skywalk: 09:00-20:30 on Google Maps.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.4, 08:00-17:00, pin; Boat Noodle Alley 4.3, Pa Yak 4.2, both trading). Seasoned Traveller (updated 18 Feb 2022). Mark Wiens Migrationology article title via a search result (not read in full).

items.name: Areeya Mu Kratha
items.nameThai: อารียา หมูกระทะ
items.gmapsQuery: Areeya Mu Kratha, 110 Pradiphat Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Moo kata sets from 399 THB (The Smart Local, Mar 2024).
dishes: Moo kata: marinated pork grilled on a domed pan with broth around the edge
Fermented fish dipping sauce
items.praise: The Smart Local (2024) likes its garden setting with a cafe feel and the fermented fish sauce, and says it fills up fast.
items.watchOut: Evenings only. No booking details found; go before 18:30 or expect a wait.
items.description: A popular Thai barbecue (moo kata) place in a garden on Pradiphat Road, open until midnight. A fun, cheap group dinner.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open 16:00-00:00, pin). The Smart Local Bangkok mookata list (updated 18 Mar 2024). Only one recent independent source found.

items.name: Banjoo Korean BBQ
items.gmapsQuery: Banjoo Korean BBQ, Mille Malle 2nd floor, Sukhumvit 20, Bangkok
items.priceText: Pork belly 350 THB, banchan 120 THB (Time Out, 2020); dry-aged wagyu rib-eye about 1,555 THB (Phuket101, Apr 2026).
dishes: Samgyeopsal pork belly grilled at the table by staff
Australian wagyu and Black Angus beef
Steamed egg, kimchi stew and refillable sides
items.praise: Time Out put it at the top of its Korean list for authentic food and grilled meat. Phuket101 (Apr 2026): premium meats, staff grill for you, refillable sides, and tables fill quickly.
items.watchOut: Book ahead, and book a private room for 8.
items.description: A Korean barbecue on the second floor of Mille Malle, Sukhumvit 20, busy with Thai and Korean diners. Good for a meat-heavy group dinner.
tips: Call 065-518-5166 to book; free parking at Mille Malle.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open until 22:30, pin). Phuket101 (updated 28 Apr 2026). Time Out review (26 Jun 2020). BK Magazine Korean BBQ list (Jul 2020).

items.name: Hobak
items.gmapsQuery: Hobak, Sukhumvit Plaza, Sukhumvit Soi 12, Bangkok
items.priceText: Grilled pork belly 290 THB, pork neck 320 THB, rib-eye 650 THB (BK Magazine, 2020; check the current menu).
dishes: Grilled pork belly and pork neck
Spicy chicken
Whole chicken soup (order an hour ahead)
items.praise: BK Magazine lists it among Bangkok's best Korean barbecue, with grilled meat as the best sellers and 1980s Seoul decor. It sits in Korea Town at Sukhumvit Plaza.
items.watchOut: Evidence is from 2020; it is still trading with a 4.3 Google rating.
items.description: A Korean barbecue in Korea Town (Sukhumvit Plaza) between Nana and Asok that stays open until early morning. The late option after the Soi 11 and Asok bars.
items.openText: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026: 11:00 until about 06:00 the next morning.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open, hours to 06:00, pin). BK Magazine list (7 Jul 2020).

items.name: Alexander's German Eatery
items.gmapsQuery: Alexander's German Eatery, Soi Charoen Chai (Ekkamai 12), Bangkok
items.priceText: Schweinshaxe (roast pork knuckle) 520 THB, Hofbräu lager 240 THB per half litre (Time Out, 2018; likely higher now).
dishes: Schweinshaxe: roast pork knuckle with crisp skin
Spätzle and baked camembert
Apple strudel
items.praise: Time Out called its pork knuckle one of the best it had tried in Bangkok, with crisp skin and tender, juicy meat; the team came from Bei Otto.
items.watchOut: Bei Otto on Sukhumvit, the old German favourite, is now permanently closed (Google Maps, Oct 2026), so this is the place for pork knuckle in Bangkok.
items.description: A German beer hall and restaurant in an Ekkamai lane, run by the former Bei Otto team. Order the pork knuckle with draught beer.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.4, open, pin). Time Out review (6 Sep 2018). Bei Otto (1/8 Sukhumvit 49) shows permanently closed on Google Maps.

items.name: Smokin' Pug
items.gmapsQuery: Smokin' Pug American BBQ, 92 Lang Suan Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: No current prices found online (Oct 2026). Phuket101 puts it in the 3 of 4 price band.
dishes: Baby back ribs
Brisket and pulled pork
Burgers
items.praise: Phuket101's Langsuan guide (Oct 2026) lists it for ribs, brisket and pulled pork. Seth Lui wrote that the baby back ribs are "worthy of the hype", and an r/Thailand thread on ribs in Thailand names it as a favourite.
items.description: An American smokehouse on Lang Suan Road, the best-known place in Bangkok for slow-smoked pork ribs.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, opens 17:00, pin). Phuket101 Langsuan guide (updated 10 Oct 2026). Seth Lui review (title and quote via search result). Reddit mention seen only in a search summary.

items.name: Wattana Panich
items.nameThai: วัฒนาพานิช
items.gmapsQuery: Wattana Panich, 336 Ekkamai Road, Bangkok
items.reviewsSource: Google Maps, via the guide's own check of 21 Oct 2026
items.priceText: Beef noodle soup about 100 THB, big bowl of stewed beef about 150 THB, goat or tendon in Chinese herbs about 200 THB (Phuket101, Apr 2025).
dishes: Beef noodle soup from a pot kept simmering since about 1974
Stewed beef and tendon
Goat in Chinese herbs
items.praise: Phuket101 (Apr 2025): third generation, dark rich broth from a giant pot topped up every day. Michelin listed it in 2018-2019.
items.watchOut: Beef and goat, not pork. Closes about 19:00.
items.description: A third-generation shop on Ekkamai Road known for beef noodle soup from a pot that has been kept going for decades. Cheap and quick.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, open 10:00-19:00, pin). Phuket101 (27 Apr 2025). Not in the Michelin 2026 selection.

items.name: Ongtong Khaosoi (Ari)
items.nameThai: อองตอง ข้าวซอย
items.gmapsQuery: Ongtong Khaosoi, 31 Phahonyothin Soi 7, Ari, Bangkok
items.priceText: No current prices found online (Oct 2026).
dishes: Khao soi: Chiang Mai curry noodle soup with crispy noodles on top
Northern Thai dishes
items.praise: Time Out's Ari guide (30 May 2026) names it as the place for khao soi in Ari.
items.description: A small northern Thai shop on Phahonyothin Soi 7 in Ari for a bowl of khao soi without going to Chiang Mai.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open, pin). Time Out Ari guide (30 May 2026).

items.name: Somboon Seafood (Surawong)
items.nameThai: สมบูรณ์โภชนา (สุรวงศ์)
items.gmapsQuery: Somboon Seafood, 169 Surawong Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Fried curry crab comes in three sizes; a small one cost 550 THB in May 2024 and may cost more now.
dishes: Fried curry crab (with roe crab or meat crab, by season)
Prawns baked with glass noodles
Fried sea bass with fish sauce
items.praise: In the Michelin selection again for 2026; Michelin credits fresh seafood, consistent cooking and fair prices, and calls this the original branch.
items.watchOut: Crab is priced by size; ask before you order.
items.description: The Thai-Chinese seafood restaurant known for fried curry crab since 1969. A big room that takes a group of 8 easily.
items.openText: Daily 11:00-22:00 (Michelin Guide and Google Maps, Oct 2026).
tips: Book a table for eight: 063-209-6969 or reservation@somboonseafood.com.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, open 11:00-22:00, pin). Michelin page (2026 selection list, hours, dishes). Price from theworldofstreetfood (May 2024).

items.name: Mae Varee
items.nameThai: แม่วารี
items.gmapsQuery: Mae Varee, 1 Thonglor (Sukhumvit 55), Bangkok
items.priceText: No 2026 menu price found; a review summary (bring-you.info) puts a box at about 150-180 THB.
dishes: Mango sticky rice with a choice of nam dok mai or ok rong mango
Sticky rice in three colours with salty coconut cream
Mango smoothies and puddings
items.praise: Time Out (May 2025): open since 1987, now run by the third generation, with coconut milk from Surat Thani made fresh every day. WAUG (Jan 2026) picks it as the top mango sticky rice shop in Bangkok.
items.watchOut: Mostly takeaway with little seating. Mango is best from about March to June; in January it is still sold, but ask which mango is best that day.
items.description: The best-known mango sticky rice shop in Bangkok, at the corner of Thonglor by the BTS station. Open from early morning to late evening.
items.openText: Daily 06:00-22:00 (Time Out, May 2025; Google Maps, Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Afternoon, when the rice is fresh.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open 06:00-22:00, pin). Time Out (2 May 2025). WAUG dessert guide (8 Jan 2026). Price range from a review summary in a search result (bring-you.info; page blocked to fetch).

items.name: After You Dessert Cafe
items.gmapsQuery: After You Dessert Cafe, Thonglor Soi 13, Bangkok
items.priceText: No current prices found online (Oct 2026).
dishes: Thai tea kakigori: shaved ice with Thai tea, tapioca pearls and jelly
Shibuya honey toast: thick toast with butter, syrup and ice cream
items.praise: WAUG (Jan 2026) names it one of the Bangkok dessert places to visit, and notes the long waits.
items.watchOut: Queues in the evening. The mall branches give you a ticket so you can shop while you wait.
items.description: A Bangkok dessert chain that started on Thonglor, famous for kakigori shaved ice and Shibuya honey toast. Branches at Siam Paragon, Siam Center and other malls.
items.openText: Thonglor Soi 13: 11:00-23:00; Siam Paragon: 10:00-22:00 (Google Maps, 27 Oct 2026).
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (Thonglor 13: 4.4, open until 23:00, pin; Siam Paragon 4.4). WAUG dessert guide (8 Jan 2026).

items.name: Yok Sod (Siam Paragon)
items.nameThai: หยกสด
items.gmapsQuery: Yok Sod Thai dessert, Siam Paragon G floor, Bangkok
items.priceText: No prices found online (Oct 2026).
dishes: Inthanin: pandan balls in coconut milk
Green coconut pudding
items.praise: Time Out (May 2025) lists it among the 7 best Thai dessert shops in Bangkok.
items.description: A Thai dessert counter in the Siam Paragon food hall that makes sweets with real pandan. Good for a quick taste of khanom Thai while shopping.
items.openText: Daily 10:00-22:00 with the mall (Google Maps, Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: Any time the mall is open.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.9 on a takeaway counter listing; the high score is backed by Time Out, May 2025). Open, pin.

items.name: Wanlamun
items.nameThai: หวานละมุน
items.gmapsQuery: Wanlamun, 95 Chan Road, Sathorn, Bangkok
items.priceText: No prices found online (Oct 2026).
dishes: Khanom tom: coconut-filled rice balls
Khanom sai sai: coconut cream wrapped in banana leaf
Khanom chan: layer cake
items.praise: Time Out (May 2025) lists it among the 7 best Thai dessert shops in Bangkok for traditional steamed sweets.
items.description: A small traditional Thai sweet shop on Chan Road that makes old-style khanom in banana leaf.
items.bestTime: Morning, when the trays are full.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.6, closed Tue evening, opens 08:00, pin). Time Out (22 May 2025).

items.name: Jae Wan
items.nameThai: เจ๊หวาน
items.gmapsQuery: Jae Wan, 1700 Banthat Thong Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: No prices found online (Oct 2026).
dishes: Thai-Chinese desserts, hot or cold, with fruit, beans and tofu pudding
items.praise: Pixidia's Banthat Thong guide (updated Oct 2026) names it for Thai-Chinese desserts.
items.description: A Thai-Chinese dessert shop on Banthat Thong Road, the late-night food street near Chulalongkorn University. Open until about 23:30.
tips: Banthat Thong Road also has milk-dessert shops open until about 01:00 (Nueng Nom Nua, Mother Cow) and egg-tart and khanom khai stalls (Phuket101, Jun 2026).
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, open until 23:30, pin). Pixidia guide (updated 18 Oct 2026). Phuket101 Banthat Thong page (16 Jun 2026) for the other late dessert shops.

items.name: Landhaus Bakery
items.gmapsQuery: Landhaus Bakery, 18 Phahonyothin Soi 5, Ari, Bangkok
items.priceText: Wholewheat sourdough 120 THB, sourdough baguette 80 THB, chocolate brioche bun 60 THB, apple crumble 160 THB (Time Out, Nov 2024).
dishes: Sourdough, baguette and rye-spelt breads
Chocolate brioche buns
Apple crumble
items.praise: Time Out lists it among Bangkok's best bakeries (Nov 2024) and best sourdough; its Ari guide (May 2026) names it for rustic breads.
items.description: A bakery and cafe in an Ari lane known for sourdough and rye breads, good for breakfast and bread to take away.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open until 19:00, pin). Time Out bakeries list (5 Nov 2024) and Ari guide (30 May 2026).

items.name: Bartels
items.gmapsQuery: Bartels Sathorn, 167/4-6 Sathorn Soi 3 (Suan Phlu), Bangkok
items.priceText: Organic sourdough loaf 250 THB, double espresso 100 THB (Time Out, Nov 2024).
dishes: Two-day fermented sourdough
Cinnamon rolls
Sourdough sandwiches
items.praise: Time Out: "ask any Bangkok bread person where to go for sourdough and Bartels usually comes up fast".
items.description: A Scandinavian-style sourdough bakery with cafes in Sathorn Soi 3 and on Sukhumvit, plus a branch at One Bangkok.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (Sathorn 4.6 and Sukhumvit 4.5, both open, pin on Sathorn). Time Out bakeries list (5 Nov 2024) and sourdough list.

items.name: Conkey's Bakery
items.gmapsQuery: Conkey's Bakery, 72 Ekkamai Soi 22, Bangkok
items.priceText: Meat pie 200 THB, sausage roll 130 THB, almond chocolate twist 140 THB, raspberry croissant 160 THB (Time Out, Nov 2024).
dishes: Sausage rolls and meat pies
Croissants and pastries
items.praise: Time Out lists it among Bangkok's best bakeries (Nov 2024). Google rating 4.7.
items.description: A bakery deep in Ekkamai known for its pork sausage rolls and meat pies as much as its pastries.
items.bestTime: Morning, before the pies sell out.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.7, 08:00-17:00, pin). Time Out bakeries list (5 Nov 2024).

items.name: Chatuchak Weekend Market (JJ): food stalls
items.nameThai: ตลาดนัดจตุจักร
items.gmapsQuery: Chatuchak Weekend Market, Kamphaeng Phet 2 Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Coconut ice cream at Coco JJ from 60 THB; paella at Viva 8 160 THB; pork boat noodles at Rattanakosin Boat Noodles 60 THB; mango sticky rice ice cream at Celin 90 THB; nasi padang or biryani at Muslim Food from 50 THB (Time Out, Jan 2025).
dishes: Coco JJ (Section 1, Soi 36): coconut ice cream in the shell
Viva 8 (Section 8): giant-pan paella
Rattanakosin Boat Noodles (Zone A 48): pork boat noodles
Muslim Food (Section 12): biryani and nasi padang
Grilled pork skewers (moo ping) and mango sticky rice from stalls across the market
items.praise: Time Out's Jan 2025 guide lists these stalls; Coco JJ has served coconut ice cream since 2008 and Viva 8's paella is cooked in a giant pan by chef Fernando (TAGTHAI, 2025).
items.watchOut: Whole market only Sat-Sun 09:00-18:00. Very hot after midday. Viva 8 has only a 4.0 Google rating: go for the show more than the food.
items.description: Bangkok's huge weekend market, with good snacks between the shopping. For a real meal, cross the road to Or Tor Kor Market.
items.openText: Whole market Sat-Sun 09:00-18:00; on weekdays only small parts open (chatuchakmarket.org).
tips: Eat a proper lunch at Or Tor Kor Market across Kamphaeng Phet Road.
Coco JJ is closed on weekdays.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (market 4.4; Coco JJ 4.5, Viva 8 4.0, both trading). Time Out Chatuchak guide (10 Jan 2025) for stalls and prices. TAGTHAI (2025) for Viva 8.

items.name: Jodd Fairs Ratchada (night market)
items.nameThai: จ๊อดแฟร์ รัชดา
items.gmapsQuery: Jodd Fairs Ratchada, Ratchadaphisek Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Leng saap pork spine 180 THB (medium, for two), 250 THB (large), 350 THB (extra large); grilled river prawns 200-450 THB; salt-crusted fish 250-400 THB; pork skewers 15-40 THB each; dinner for two 600-1,200 THB with drinks (Travjoy 2026 guide).
dishes: Leng saap "volcano ribs": a heap of pork spine in sour, spicy broth
Grilled river prawns and salt-crusted grilled fish
Pork skewers and grilled meats
Mango sticky rice, khanom krok and shaved ice in the dessert zone
items.praise: Travjoy (2026) calls it Bangkok's busiest night market for eating. At the old Rama 9 site the leng saap stall, Leng Zapp Volcano Ribs, drew a steady crowd; a 2026 Chinese-language guide still lists volcano ribs among the popular dishes at Ratchada.
items.watchOut: Some map apps still show the closed Rama 9 site: go to Ratchadaphisek Road next to Big C. Most stalls take cash or Thai QR only.
items.description: The busiest food night market in Bangkok, with about 800 stalls, mostly food, plus bars and live music. The best group evening for pork in the city.
items.openText: Daily 17:00-01:00 (official Facebook page; Google Maps Oct 2026).
items.bestTime: 17:30-19:00 for free tables; packed after 20:00 on Fri-Sat.
tips: Order leng saap one size smaller than you think.
MRT Thailand Cultural Centre exit 4, then 3 minutes on foot.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.2, opens 17:00, hours 17:00-01:00, pin). Travjoy 2026 guide (dishes and prices; it names no stalls). Stall name from an older Rama 9 report via a search result.

items.name: Or Tor Kor Market
items.nameThai: ตลาด อ.ต.ก.
items.gmapsQuery: Or Tor Kor Market, 101 Kamphaeng Phet Road, Bangkok
items.priceText: Khao kha moo (braised pork leg on rice) 80 THB at the food court (The World of Street Food, May 2024).
dishes: Khao kha moo from the food court
Thai desserts at Khao Pee Nong, the main branch of a Thai sweet shop: luk chup, thong yip, sangkhaya with sticky rice
Top-grade mangoes, durian and other fruit
Ready-to-eat curries and grilled seafood
items.praise: The World of Street Food (May 2024) calls it clean, well run and one of the best places in Bangkok for produce, and the pork leg very tender. Time Out (May 2025) lists Khao Pee Nong, whose main shop is here. Phuket101 (Jul 2026) suggests it for breakfast or lunch on a Chatuchak day.
items.watchOut: Prices are higher than at ordinary markets, for better quality.
items.description: One of Bangkok's best fresh markets, across the road from Chatuchak, with a food court for lunch, Thai desserts and top-quality fruit.
tips: MRT Kamphaeng Phet is next to it.
Buy mango and durian here rather than in tourist areas.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.3, open 06:00-18:00, pin; Kanomthai Kaopeenong 4.5 listed on Kamphaeng Phet Road). The World of Street Food (6 May 2024). Time Out Thai desserts (22 May 2025). Phuket101 Chatuchak page (15 Jul 2026).

items.name: Pier 21 food court (Terminal 21)
items.gmapsQuery: Pier 21 food court, Terminal 21, Sukhumvit Road, Asok, Bangkok
items.priceText: Stewed pork leg rice with egg 37 THB, pork leg with roast pork 47 THB, pork leg with intestine and two eggs 89 THB at Kha Moo Nakornchaisri, stall 9 (thai.lt, Mar 2026).
dishes: Khao kha moo at Kha Moo Nakornchaisri (stall 9)
Noodles, curries and som tam from dozens of counters
items.praise: thai.lt (Mar 2026) reviews its stalls one by one; prices stay close to street level, in an air-conditioned mall at Asok BTS. Google rating 4.5.
items.watchOut: Very busy 12:00-13:00 with office workers.
items.description: The top-floor food court of Terminal 21 at Asok, with Thai street dishes at local prices. Easy for 8 people who all want something different.
items.verification: Google Maps 27 Oct 2026 (4.5, open 10:00-22:00, pin). thai.lt stall review (updated 24 Mar 2026).
